For names, the document is the legal instrument — but the rule about "genuinely different names = best_value = document's". For same-entity, presumably we pick the more correct form. The document form "Esit Elektronik A.Ş." has correct spelling ("Elektronik" = correct Turkish spelling). The register has a typo "Elektonik". The document is the legal instrument, so its form should be preferred. Also "Esit Elektronik" is the actual company name. So best_value = "Esit Elektronik A.Ş." (document's).

The rules: same-entity verdict — the rule only specifies best_value explicitly for the different-entity case (document's) and for number format (register canonical). For same-entity name drift, the most sensible fused value is the document's since the certificate is the legal instrument, and here it also happens to be the correctly spelled one.
